what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Afghanistan in Bulgaria: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 367 Afghan asylum seekers in Bulgaria, 0.1% of all asylum seekers from Afghanistan.
Refugees from Afghanistan, a separate group, live mostly in Pakistan, Iran, Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1995 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 428 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 7636, at the end of 2016; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016, 2021 and 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Bulgaria.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Bulgaria only.
